spanish: Y volvió Moisés a Jehová y dijo: Adonai, ¿por qué has hecho mal a este pueblo? ¿Por qué esto me enviaste?

findings.issue: אֲדֹנָי is a common noun with 1cs suffix (my Lord), not a proper name; dumping untranslated Adonai is not licensed—Spanish Señor / mi Señor is required
¿Por qué esto me enviaste? can read as “send this to me,” but morphology has 1cs as object of send and זֶה with לָמָּה; wording leaves the licensed roles uncertain

notes: Narrative return/speech and hiphil harm-to-this-people are licensed; fail is the Adonai dump.
